title: Lui's Vanilla
description: Performance and visual-focused client-side Fabric modpack.
body:

This is a client-side Fabric modpack for Minecraft 1.21.1 focused on visual enhancements and graphical immersion, while preserving the original vanilla gameplay.

🎨 Visual & Graphical Improvements

The modpack enhances Minecraft’s visuals using Iris Shaders support, advanced entity models and textures, connected textures, dynamic lighting, and improved animations. Particles, sound effects, and subtle visual details are refined to make the world feel more alive and immersive without changing its core style.

![Village](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d6aebc372f089118a9e66805d1de19f8615d1f17.jpeg)

🖥️ Interface & Visual Feedback

The user interface is visually improved with cleaner menus, smoother GUI elements, animated interactions, customizable crosshair, zoom, and enhanced chat visuals. Inventory actions, hotbar interactions, and on-screen feedback feel more responsive and polished.

![Inventory](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/59ae11bb9a3fb4322d2e69ebd578ec2cdad3b798.jpeg)

🔊 Audio & Atmosphere

Sound behavior is enhanced to better match in-game actions, adding depth and realism to movement, environment interactions, and combat.

🎥 Recording & Replay

Includes replay and recording tools, making this modpack suitable for capturing cinematic shots, gameplay clips, and content creation.
